_comment: Process onboarding example (2026-11-10): collections payment request lifecycle (BASE) and the Stripe premium refund - control BASE_REJECTS, proposal P2, checks R1-R4 (config/control_seed.md section 2a, docs/USAA_Known_Tables.md). Input of tools/abaptools/new_process.py; every row is delivered INACTIVE with placeholders (text in angle quotes) because the status table, its fields, the reject value and the refund log are not confirmed (VERIFY-SE11). Activate only after the questions of section 2a are answered and the placeholders replaced.
name: Collections payment request lifecycle (BASE)

checks.description: R1 PENDING past its request date (fund account validation)

aggregates.description: Oldest PENDING request past its request date

checks.description: R2 SCHEDULED, no answer of the source (BASE) in n hours
R3 source reject without a successful Stripe refund
R4 SRCPOSTED not collected by FPY1 on the request date

aggregates.description: SRCPOSTED requests past their request date

verify: VERIFY-SE11: the table and field that hold the request status (PENDING, SCHEDULED, SRCPOSTED) and the value of a source reject; one row per request or per status change (one row per change: R1, R4 and the R2 class need the latest row of a request - a check class, not an aggregate); the date of the request and of the status change; the company-code field (config/control_seed.md section 2a, question 1).
Where the incoming SRCPOSTED / reject of BASE is logged (question 2) and what a failed fund account validation sets (question 3).

The table of SAP's Stripe refund call: key back to the request (FIN number / payment intent), status field, success / failure values, time stamp (question 4) - the one anti-join read of COLL_R3_REFUND in its data access class (OSQL test).

Limits: hours allowed for R2 and R3 (question 5) and the time-stamp field each limit counts from. Decision D-PO3 (approved 2026-11-10): limits in hours are checked by the check classes ZCL_CD_COLL_C_NO_ANSWER (R2) and ZCL_CD_COLL_C_REFUND (R3), not by no-code rows (they count days).
Index of the status table that starts with the status field (and the company-code field) for R1, R4 and R2 (docs/VERIFY.md of the framework, V48).

Area CD_COLL in ZCA_PARAM_AREA, role Z_CD_OPS_COLL (config/auth_zcd_ops.md; display of CD_COLL is already in business role ZCD_OPS_PROD_SUPPORT since 2026-11-10), SO23 list of rule COLL_LIFE, owner and backup of the process in DV1.
